skills.name: gate-caller
skills.description: Evaluate sample handoff records using the gate-contract dependency. Use when asked to classify runtime-gate handoffs.

skills.name: gate-contract
skills.description: Interpret runtime-gate handoff records. Use when a caller classifies these handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Interpret runtime-gate handoff records

skills.name: dev-skills:agentic-review
skills.description: Review a pull request, or the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base): parallel Finders look for problems on the standards, spec and adversarial angles, a Verifier checks each candidate against the code, and the survivors are ranked by Severity. A pull request is reviewed in Rounds (2 to 5), each posting one comment. Use when the user wants to review a PR, a branch, work-in-progress changes, run a ticket check, or asks to "review since X".

interface.shortDescription: Find, verify and rank review Findings, in Rounds

skills.name: dev-skills:ask-matt
skills.description: Route the user to the right skill or flow for their situation, from idea to ship. Use when the user asks which skill to use, where to start a new piece of work, or how the skills fit together.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right skill or workflow

skills.name: dev-skills:codebase-design
skills.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

interface.shortDescription: Vocabulary for deep-module design

skills.name: dev-skills:diagnosing-bugs
skills.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose hard bugs and regressions

skills.name: dev-skills:domain-modeling
skills.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing the glossary (GLOSSARY.md, GLOSSARY-MAP.md or its pages), or recording or editing an ADR.

interface.shortDescription: Build and sharpen a domain model

skills.name: dev-skills:grill-with-docs
skills.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design, recording glossary terms and ADRs as decisions settle. Use when the user says "grill me" or wants a plan or design stress-tested while working in a repo.

interface.shortDescription: Grill a design and write its docs

skills.name: dev-skills:grilling
skills.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when there is no working directory to record in, or the user wants only the interview with nothing written down; in a repo, grill-with-docs is the default.

interface.shortDescription: Stress-test thinking a round of questions at a time

skills.name: dev-skills:handoff
skills.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for a fresh agent to continue from. Use when the user says "handoff" or "hand off", or the work moves to a new harness, directory or colleague, or a side task forks off mid-phase.

interface.shortDescription: Compact a conversation into a handoff

skills.name: dev-skills:implement
skills.description: Build one lone Ticket as its Ticket thread: an Implementer subagent builds it test-first and shows evidence, you open the pull request with pr, run the agentic-review Rounds, then merge or bring the pull request to the user. Use when you are handed a lone Ticket (a bug fix, chore or small feature under no Spec) to build and ship.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate one lone ticket: Implementer, PR, review Rounds, merge

skills.name: dev-skills:implement-spec
skills.description: Build one Spec as its Spec thread: Implementer subagents build its Tickets test-first in local worktrees off one Spec branch, each Ticket passes a ticket check and is squash-merged in, you open the Spec pull request with pr as a draft after the first Ticket lands, then run the agentic-review Rounds once the last has landed, and merge it into main with a merge commit or bring it to the user. Use when you are handed a Spec (the result of to-spec and to-tickets) to build and ship.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate one spec: worktree Implementers, ticket checks, spec PR, Rounds

skills.name: dev-skills:improve-codebase-architecture
skills.description: Scan a whole codebase for refactors that turn shallow modules into deep ones, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through the one the user picks. Use when the user asks to improve the architecture, find refactoring candidates, or review the codebase's structure.

interface.shortDescription: Find and grill architecture improvements

skills.name: dev-skills:pr
skills.description: Use when writing a PR title and body.

interface.shortDescription: Write a PR title and body that's fast to review

skills.name: dev-skills:prototype
skills.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.

interface.shortDescription: Prototype to answer a design question

skills.name: dev-skills:release
skills.description: Cut a Release and plan the next one: check every issue with the release label is closed, pick the patch, minor or major bump from what shipped, open the bump pull request with its changelog entry for the user to merge, then run the Release planning: propose the next Release's goal and scope. Use when the user wants to cut a release, plan the next release, or ship an urgent fix as its own patch Release.

interface.shortDescription: Cut a Release and plan the next one

skills.name: dev-skills:research
skills.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.

interface.shortDescription: Research from high-trust sources

skills.name: dev-skills:retro
skills.description: Review a finished coding session or pull request and propose improvements to the agent's environment (navigation pointers, automated checks, coding standards, docs). Use when the user asks for a retro or retrospective on a session or pull request, or what went wrong in it and how to stop it recurring; the Retro backlog is retro-planning.

interface.shortDescription: Conduct a retrospective on a coding session.

skills.name: dev-skills:retro-planning
skills.description: Work through this repo's Retro backlog: snapshot the open Retro issues, group them by root cause, walk the user through each group one at a time and act on each call at once (a Ticket, a close, or a spin-off to its own planning), keeping an open record that is closed at the end. Use when Retro planning is due, or to resume one whose record is still open.

interface.shortDescription: Work through a repository's Retro backlog

skills.name: dev-skills:setup-dev-skills
skills.description: Configure a GitHub repo for the dev-skills plugin: write its issue tracker, triage label, domain doc and release doc files, create the labels the skills use, and check the GitHub settings the build skills rely on. Use when the user sets up a repo for these skills, or the repo has no issue tracker or triage labels configured yet, or asks to update the repo's tracker, label, domain-doc or release-doc files.

interface.shortDescription: Configure a repository for the development skills

skills.name: dev-skills:setup-project
skills.description: Drafts a project's instructions for its coordinator: how its threads work, never the state of its work. Use when the user wants to write or update a project's instructions, or when a new repo, kind of thread or standing rule means they are out of date.

interface.shortDescription: Draft or update a project's coordinator instructions

skills.name: dev-skills:tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

interface.shortDescription: Test-driven red-green-refactor

skills.name: dev-skills:to-spec
skills.description: Synthesise the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker, with no interview. Use when the user says "write the spec", "turn this into a spec" or "make a PRD" once the plan is settled.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a conversation into a spec

skills.name: dev-skills:to-tickets
skills.description: Split a plan, spec or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring what blocks it, and publish them to the tracker. Use when the user says "break this into tickets" or "split into issues", or asks for vertical slices of an existing spec.

interface.shortDescription: Split a plan into tracer-bullet tickets

skills.name: dev-skills:triage
skills.description: Move issues and external PRs through the triage roles (category and state), verify them, and write agent-ready briefs. Use when the user says "triage" or asks to look at incoming issues or external PRs.

interface.shortDescription: Move issues through triage roles

skills.name: dev-skills:wayfinder
skills.description: Chart work too big for one agent session as a map of decision tickets on the issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the route is clear. Use when the user has a large, foggy effort too big for one session (for example "wayfind this" or "map this out"), before any spec exists.

interface.shortDescription: Map a large effort as decision tickets

skills.name: dev-skills:wizard
skills.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.

interface.shortDescription: Generate an interactive setup wizard

skills.name: dev-skills:writing-for-agents
skills.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

interface.shortDescription: Write documents agents consume
